title: CONNECT_PERSIST does not work with resources and sub-resources
body:
### Tested versions

4.6.1

### System information

Godot v4.6.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8183) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10750H CPU @ 2.60GHz (12 threads) - 15.84 GiB memory

### Issue description

In the case where you have:
- a resource of type B that contains an array of resources of type A 
- a signal in A connected to a function in B

Then:
Using CONNECT_PERSIST does not make the connections survive reloading the scene or reloading the project.

My original problem was that the connection survived reloading the scene but did not survive reloading the project. But when I tried to produce a minimal reproduction project, I had the issue as soon as I reload the scene.

See the code here:
```gdscript
class_name A extends Resource

@export var name:String
@export var size:float = 5.0:
	set(value):
		size = value
		transformed.emit()

signal transformed
```
```gdscript
@tool
class_name B extends Resource

@export var selected_objects:Array[A]

signal transformed

func emit_transformed():
	transformed.emit()

func add_node(size:float=5.0) -> A:
	var object:A = A.new()
	object.transformed.connect(emit_transformed, CONNECT_PERSIST)
	object.size = size
	selected_objects.append(object)
	transformed.emit()
	return object
```
```gdscript
@tool
class_name ParentOfB extends Node

@export_tool_button("Add new objects", "Add") var action1 = add_object
@export var resource_b:B

func _ready():
	print("ready")
	if resource_b == null:
		resource_b = B.new()
	resource_b.transformed.connect(on_transformed)

func add_object():
	resource_b.add_node(7.0)

func on_transformed():
	print("was transformed!")
```

### Steps to reproduce

- Download the MRP
- open main.tscn
- add a node, select "ParentOfB"
- click on + add new objects in the inspector of ParentOfB
- navigate to the A resource variable and modify the "size"
- observe that in the Output tab, the message "was transformed" is printed each time you modify "size"
- save
- reload the scene
- modify the size of a A resource in ParentOfB and observe that the message "was transformed" is not printed anymore

Note: if you click on + add new objects and modify the size of the new A resource, the message "was transformed" will appear for that new resource.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[testing-persist-connection.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25853571/testing-persist-connection.zip)
